name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
summary: Following his rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, Zenitsu became significantly stronger and faster. He learned Total Concentration: Constant and continued developing his Thunder Breathing techniques. During the Entertainment District Arc, he was able to keep up with Awakened Daki and further enhanced his Thunderclap and Flash through Eightfold and Godspeed.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

weaknesses: Using Godspeed twice in a day makes him unable to use his legs
notes: Zenitsu's Post-Rehabilitation Training key. He gained Total Concentration: Constant and significantly improved his physical abilities. His Thunderclap and Flash can be enhanced through Sixfold, Eightfold, and Godspeed. Godspeed greatly increases his speed but places severe strain on his legs. His practical experience against Upper Rank 6 allowed him to rapidly develop during battle.
